sourceReview.assessment: Japan comprises many islands and is mountainous, with extensive forest. The book omits disputed borders, territorial counts and political settings. Along Egypt’s Nile, green irrigated fields and urban places contrast with surrounding dry desert. One connected river-edge scene supports the comparison.
